name: SideNavMenu

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Specifies whether the menu should be expanded by default.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Indicates whether the SideNavMenu is active.

props.name: isSideNavExpanded
props.description: Indicates if the side navigation container is expanded or collapsed.

props.name: large
props.description: Specifies whether the SideNavMenu is in a large variation.

props.name: renderIcon
props.description: A component used to render an icon.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon SideNavMenu rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
